sections.①:
• 브랜드명: Tving (티빙)
  • 한 줄 정체성: CJ ENM의 콘텐츠 경쟁력에 라이브·스포츠·오리지널을 결합한 한국 OTT
  • 공식 디자인 철학: 공개 디자인 시스템은 확인되지 않으며, 제품은 콘텐츠 발견과 즉시 시청을 우선하는 다크 인터페이스로 관찰됨
  • 시그니처 요소 1개: 검은 콘텐츠 월을 가르는 Tving Red(#FF153C) 워드마크와 랭킹 숫자
sections.②:
• 핵심 키워드 3개: 시네마틱, 다크, 예능 우선
  • 무드 설명: 검은 캔버스는 영상 썸네일의 색을 선명하게 띄우고, Tving Red는 워드마크·오리지널·라이브 상태에 제한적으로 집중된다. 큰 콘텐츠 배너와 촘촘한 랭킹 행이 방송 편성표와 OTT 탐색 경험을 함께 만든다.
  • 비주얼 스타일: 모던 미니멀
  • 밀도(Density): Compact — 한 화면에서 라이브·랭킹·장르별 콘텐츠를 빠르게 훑도록 행 간격을 촘촘하게 유지
  • 모서리 성향: Round (6~10px)
  • 평면성: Layered
sections.④:
• 한글 Pretendard, 영문 -apple-system
  • Display 64/800/1.05 / H1 32/800/1.15 / H2 22/700/1.25 / H3 16/700/1.3
  • Body 13/500 / Small 12/500 / Caption 11/700
sections.⑦:
--shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.30);
--shadow-md: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.50);
--shadow-lg: 0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.70);
--shadow-xl: 0 24px 60px rgba(255,21,60,0.30);
sections.⑨:
Button

.btn { font: 800 14px/1 Pretendard,sans-serif; letter-spacing:-0.01em; border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 12px 22px; border: 0; cursor: pointer; }
.btn-play { background: #fff; color: #000; }
.btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: #fff; }
.btn-secondary { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.20); color: #fff; }
.btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #fff; }
.btn-danger { background: var(--color-error-fg); color: #fff; }

Input

.input { background: rgba(22,22,22,0.66); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 14px; color: #fff; font-family: inherit; }
.input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #fff; }

Card

.poster { aspect-ratio: 2/3; background: var(--bg-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 200ms ease; }
.poster:hover { transform: scale(1.05); z-index: 2; }
.card { background: var(--bg-elevated); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 16px; }

Badge

.tag { padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; }
.tag-original { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: #fff; }
.tag-solid { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: #fff; }
.tag-subtle { background: rgba(255,21,60,0.18); color: var(--color-primary-300); }
.tag-outline { border: 1px solid #fff; color: #fff; background: transparent; }

Navigation

.topnav { padding: 14px 16px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.85), transparent); position: sticky; top: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; z-index: 10; }
.topnav .brand { font-weight: 900; color: var(--color-primary-500); font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: -0.04em; }
sections.⑪: 1. brand red를 본문 텍스트에 사용 금지 2. 라이트 테마 강제 금지 — 다크가 시청 톤 3. TVING 워드마크 letter-spacing(-0.04em) 변경 금지 4. 포스터를 sharp 0px로 변경 금지 — 8px round가 시그니처 5. ORIGINAL 배지 색을 brand red 외 변경 금지
sections.⑫:
<style>
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  body { margin: 0; background: var(--bg-base); color: var(--text-primary); font-family: Pretendard,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.02em; }
  .tving-shell { min-height: 100vh; overflow: hidden; background: var(--bg-base); }
  .tving-nav { height: 68px; padding: 0 clamp(20px,4vw,64px); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 34px; position: absolute; inset: 0 0 auto; z-index: 10; background: linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,0,0,.94),transparent); }
  .tving-logo { color: var(--color-primary-500); font-size: 30px; font-weight: 950; letter-spacing: -.065em; }
  .tving-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 24px; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; }
  .tving-nav-links span:first-child { color: var(--text-primary); }
  .tving-nav-tools { margin-left: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; color: var(--text-secondary); }
  .tving-search { width: 34px; height: 34px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-full); display: grid; place-items: center; }
  .tving-avatar { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: linear-gradient(145deg,#3A3A3A,#161616); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); }

  .tving-hero { min-height: 560px; position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; padding: 110px clamp(20px,6vw,92px) 92px; overflow: hidden; background: radial-gradient(circle at 76% 24%,rgba(255,138,157,.34),transparent 18%),linear-gradient(112deg,#050505 0%,#290811 42%,#72172C 70%,#16070B 100%); }
  .tving-hero::before { content:"X"; position: absolute; right: 3vw; top: 32px; z-index: -1; font-size: clamp(260px,38vw,610px); line-height: .9; font-weight: 950; color: rgba(255,255,255,.045); letter-spacing: -.12em; }
  .tving-hero::after { content:""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background: linear-gradient(90deg,#000 0%,rgba(0,0,0,.82) 34%,transparent 70%),linear-gradient(0deg,#000 0%,transparent 46%); }
  .tving-cast { position: absolute; right: clamp(8px,8vw,120px); bottom: 26px; width: min(48vw,570px); height: 84%; z-index: -1; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: center; gap: 1%; filter: drop-shadow(0 28px 38px rgba(0,0,0,.55)); }
  .tving-person { width: 29%; height: 78%; position: relative; border-radius: 48% 48% 12% 12%; background: linear-gradient(90deg,#20191C,#57313A 48%,#191417); clip-path: polygon(21% 0,79% 0,88% 22%,100% 100%,0 100%,12% 22%); }
  .tving-person::before { content:""; position: absolute; left: 27%; top: -8%; width: 46%; aspect-ratio: .82; border-radius: 45% 45% 50% 50%; background: linear-gradient(110deg,#56332D,#D6A28E 48%,#7D4439); box-shadow: 0 -12px 0 3px #211619; }
  .tving-person:nth-child(1) { height: 66%; opacity: .75; transform: translateX(28px); }
  .tving-person:nth-child(2) { height: 86%; background: linear-gradient(90deg,#171A22,#434D66,#15171D); z-index: 2; }
  .tving-person:nth-child(3) { height: 72%; opacity: .82; transform: translateX(-26px); }
  .tving-hero-copy { width: min(500px,58%); position: relative; z-index: 2; }
  .tving-original { color: #FF5874; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .13em; }
  .tving-title { margin: 10px 0 12px; font-size: clamp(48px,7vw,92px); line-height: .92; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: -.065em; }
  .tving-title em { color: var(--color-primary-500); font-style: normal; }
  .tving-meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 14px; color: #E4E4E4; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; }
  .tving-description { max-width: 430px; margin: 0 0 22px; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.65; }
  .tving-actions { display: flex; gap: 10px; }
  .tving-actions .btn { min-width: 112px; display: inline-flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }

  .tving-features { padding: 8px clamp(20px,4vw,64px) 64px; }
  .tving-section-head { margin: 0 0 16px; display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; }
  .tving-section-head h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 21px; font-weight: 850; }
  .tving-section-head span { color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 12px; }
  .tving-feature-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 12px; }
  .tving-feature-card { min-height: 236px; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); overflow: hidden; position: relative; background: var(--bg-elevated); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); transition: transform var(--duration-base) var(--ease-out); }
  .tving-feature-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
  .tving-card-art { height: 148px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
  .tving-card-copy { padding: 14px 16px 16px; }
  .tving-card-copy strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 5px; font-size: 15px; }
  .tving-card-copy p { margin: 0; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; }

  .tving-rank-art { background: radial-gradient(circle at 70% 28%,#E8B099 0 10%,transparent 10.5%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 62%,#34405A 0 27%,transparent 27.5%),linear-gradient(140deg,#162842,#05070B 78%); }
  .tving-rank-number { position: absolute; left: 10px; bottom: -26px; color: #fff; font-size: 116px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 950; font-style: italic; text-shadow: 0 8px 24px #000; }
  .tving-only { position: absolute; right: 10px; top: 10px; background: var(--color-primary-500); color: #fff; padding: 4px 6px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .03em; }
  .tving-live-art { padding: 18px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 80% 18%,rgba(255,21,60,.42),transparent 32%),linear-gradient(145deg,#211016,#090909 70%); }
  .tving-live-top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-secondary); }
  .tving-live-dot { color: #fff; background: var(--color-primary-500); padding: 4px 7px; border-radius: 3px; font-weight: 900; }
  .tving-chat { width: fit-content; max-width: 84%; margin-top: 10px; padding: 8px 11px; border-radius: 5px 12px 12px 12px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.1); color: #EAEAEA; font-size: 11px; }
  .tving-chat:nth-of-type(3) { margin-left: auto; background: rgba(255,21,60,.22); }
  .tving-score-art { padding: 18px; background: linear-gradient(145deg,#073C29,#07130F 72%); }
  .tving-score-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; color: #B6C9C0; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; }
  .tving-score { height: 88px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; align-items: center; text-align: center; }
  .tving-team-mark { width: 42px; height: 42px; margin: 0 auto 6px; border-radius: var(--radius-full); display: grid; place-items: center; background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 950; }
  .tving-score strong { font-size: 28px; }
  .tving-score small { color: #B6C9C0; }
  @media (max-width:720px) {
    .tving-nav-links { display:none; }
    .tving-hero { min-height:520px; }
    .tving-hero-copy { width:78%; }
    .tving-cast { right:-60px; opacity:.58; width:64vw; }
    .tving-feature-grid { grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  }
</style>

<main class="tving-shell">
  <header class="tving-nav">
    <div class="tving-logo">TVING</div>
    <nav class="tving-nav-links"><span>홈</span><span>시리즈</span><span>영화</span><span>라이브</span><span>스포츠</span></nav>
    <div class="tving-nav-tools"><span class="tving-search">⌕</span><span class="tving-avatar"></span></div>

  <section class="tving-hero">
    <div class="tving-cast" aria-hidden="true"><i class="tving-person"></i><i class="tving-person"></i><i class="tving-person"></i></div>

      <div class="tving-original">TVING ORIGINAL</div>
      <h1 class="tving-title">환승연애 <em>4</em></h1>

        <button class="btn btn-play">▶ 시청하기</button>
        <button class="btn btn-secondary">＋ 찜</button>

  </section>

  <section class="tving-features">
    <div class="tving-section-head"><h2>지금 티빙에서</h2><span>더보기 〉</span></div>
    <div class="tving-feature-grid">
      <article class="tving-feature-card">
        <div class="tving-card-art tving-rank-art"><span class="tving-rank-number">1</span><span class="tving-only">V ONLY</span></div>

      </article>
      <article class="tving-feature-card">
        <div class="tving-card-art tving-live-art">
          <div class="tving-live-top"><span class="tving-live-dot">● 같이볼래 LIVE</span><span>1.8K 시청 중</span></div>

        <div class="tving-card-copy"><strong>놓치지 않는 스포츠</strong><p>현재 스코어와 경기 흐름을 한눈에 확인하고 생중계로 이동합니다.</p></div>
